description: Bounded Israel tax-benefit pilot: the full section-level text of the Income Tax Ordinance [New Version] (Knesset IsraelLawID 2000944) and the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version] 5755-1995 (2000198), for supervised RuleSpec-IL encoding.
